name: virtual-list
title: Virtual List
description: A virtualized list that renders only the rows in view, for thousands of items of any height, with list semantics and a named, keyboard-reachable scroll region, as a React wrapper over React Virtuoso.
label: React Virtuoso
author: Petyo Ivanov <https://github.com/petyosi>

props.name: totalCount / data
props.description: How many rows there are, or the items themselves (then `itemContent` receives each one).

props.name: itemContent
props.description: Renders one row. Rows may have any height; Virtuoso measures them.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: Names the scroll region (it becomes a labelled region). Name every list.

props.name: style / className
props.description: Give the list a height (`style={{ height: 320 }}` or a class), or use `useWindowScroll`. The class goes on the scroll region.

props.name: initialItemCount
props.description: Rows rendered on the server and before the first measure, so the list is not empty before hydration.

props.name: computeItemKey
props.description: A stable key per row (by default the index).

props.name: followOutput
props.description: Keeps a chat-like list at the bottom as rows are added. "smooth" becomes a jump under reduced motion.

props.name: endReached / startReached / rangeChanged
props.description: Load more at either end, or follow which rows are visible.

props.name: components
props.description: Replace Virtuoso's parts (Header, Footer, EmptyPlaceholder, Item, List, Scroller). Replacing List or Item drops the wrapper's list semantics: add role list and listitem yourself.

props.name: ref
props.description: scrollToIndex, scrollIntoView, scrollTo, scrollBy, autoscrollToBottom and getState; a `behavior: "smooth"` scroll becomes a jump under reduced motion.

props.name: ...Virtuoso props
props.description: Every other Virtuoso prop passes through (overscan, increaseViewportBy, firstItemIndex, initialTopMostItemIndex, alignToBottom, horizontalDirection, useWindowScroll, customScrollParent, context, and more).

a11y: The rows are a list: the list element has role list and each rendered row role listitem with aria-setsize (the whole list's size) and aria-posinset (its position), so a screen reader reports "item 5,001 of 10,000" although only a window of rows is in the page.

The scroll region is keyboard reachable (Virtuoso gives it tabindex 0; arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End scroll it) and, when named with aria-label or aria-labelledby, is a labelled region. Virtuoso removes its focus outline; the wrapper draws a focus ring (focus-visible) instead.
Rows outside the window are not in the page, so the browser's find-in-page and a screen reader's browse mode see only rendered rows; give long lists a search or filter.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, smooth scrolls requested through the handle or followOutput jump instead.
Right to left: the vertical list follows the page direction; for a horizontal list (horizontalDirection) Virtuoso reads the scroll direction itself.
